column5: Reed BLANKS are outer-wall-weighted material (inner parenchyma partly gouged away, polished) - stiffer and denser than whole-wall or heel material; the paper quantifies the radial gradient as power laws rho(h)=rho0*h^n and E(h)=E0*h^n with n between -1.28 and -1.82 for E (Table 2): thinner strips closer to the pure cortex are much stiffer, which is why these values sit far above reed-HEEL packs (see cane-arundo-reedheel-mdpi-ma13204566) - two zones of one plant, recorded separately, never averaged; strips are commercially dried with no stated relative humidity, so moisture stays a named unknown; per-brand means recorded as a printed range low/high (brands P=778.9 and M=963.3 kg/m3; E brands P=15.0 and M=24.8 GPa), never averaged across brands
